ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in Southern South America changed by +0.250 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.166 to +0.332), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.618 °C.

ranking.name: Water running off the surface
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water running off the surface in Southern South America shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.59): the estimate is +0.0014 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.0040 to +0.0068). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
